nodes.text: called. There was a man at the king's court who was named Nectanebo. The greatest sorcerer
he was. By his spells and sorceries he brought it about that he managed to sleep with the queen herself.
Because of that many believed Alexander to be his son and not King Philip's. But his deeds have since nevertheless truly
